items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: It was Dootsie Williams and the Chocolate Drops, so I was one of the Chocolate Drops.

ctx.x: Was'it called -- was it in his name, I mean, was --
Dootsie Williams. It was Dootsie Williams and the Chocolate Drops, so I was one of the Chocolate Drops.
Okay. When you were talking about your first recording and your test records -- was that what Dave Dexter called them, that he asked you to do?
